title: Soak it up in East! 8 beds 3.5 bath Garage incl!
description:
Soak up the sun in this bright and spacious condo! Located in East Nashville, this place is a short walk from many bars and restaurants, as well as a short cab to and from downtown, the grand ole opry, and both stadiums!

This condo is professionally decorated to give you a unique experience that you can remember long after you leave, and even come back to again!

The space
This property is 4 stories:

First Floor:
 :: Garage and entry
 :: Bedroom with 2 Queen beds
 :: Full Bathroom

Second Floor
 :: Full Kitchen and breakfast bar
 :: Living Area with TV
 :: 2 Bunk Room
 :: Half Bath
 :: Laundry Room

Third Floor
 :: Bedroom with 3 Queen beds
 :: Full Bathroom
 :: Master bedroom with Full bathroom

Fourth Floor
 :: Rooftop Sun Deck!

Guest access
This is an entire private condo for rent, garage included. 

You may check in any time after 3PM on your check-in date. If you are going to check in late, please let us know so we can give you any contingency check-in plans!

Other things to note
We do not host any locals. No parties, and no gatherings of any sort. 

We do require a rental agreement to be signed outside of Airbnb.
